On November 6, 2026, Atmus Filtration Technologies Inc. (“the Company”) issued the attached press release reporting its financial results for the third quarter of 2026. A copy of this press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and is incorporated herein by reference. The information furnished in this Item 2.02, including Exhibit 99.1, is not deemed to be “filed” for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), or otherwise subject to the liability of that section. This information will not be deemed to be incorporated by reference into any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “Securities Act”), or the Exchange Act, except to the extent that the Company specifically incorporates it by reference. Item 8.01 Other Events. Also in the press release issued on November 6, 2026, the Company announced that its Board of Directors approved a new stock repurchase program, which authorizes the Company to purchase up to $300 million of its outstanding shares of common stock, effective immediately. The new program replaces the Company’s previous stock repurchase program, which had $28.9 million of remaining repurchase authorization. A copy of the press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 hereto. Under the new program, stock repurchases may be executed through open market or in privately negotiated transactions, including repurchase plans that satisfy the conditions of Rule 10b5-1 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended. The Company expects to use cash generated by operations and cash on hand to fund repurchases under the new program. The new program does not obligate the Company to repurchase any dollar amount or number of shares. The new program does not have an expiration date and may be suspended or discontinued at any time.
